title: The overworld direction labels (go north/south/east/west) are frequently flavor-only and don't consistently match the compass description in the room text (e.g. Hollow Path's 'east' led to Wolf Scrape, not the described sunken shrine); had to rely on status's 'as the wood/vale runs' bearings feature to actually navigate.
